You are grading a question-answering benchmark. Judge each item on its own.

For an "answer" item: is the model answer the same answer as any gold answer?
Count it correct when it names the same entity, value or yes/no decision, even
with different wording, extra title words, or a short explanation. Count it
wrong when it is a different entity, hedges between options, says it cannot
answer, or adds a claim that contradicts the gold answer.

For an "evidence" item: list the indexes of the gold sentences whose fact is
stated by the evidence text. A fact is stated when a reader of the evidence
alone would learn it (same entity, same claim, same date or number when the
sentence has one). Be strict: topic overlap or a generic description of the
same subject is not enough. Return an empty list when none.

Write verdicts.json as a JSON array with one object per item, in any order:
{"id": "...", "correct": true}             for answer items
{"id": "...", "supported": [0, 2]}          for evidence items
Use only ids from items.json and do not skip any item.

gold_answers: Central London Property Trust Ltd v High Trees House Ltd ( 1947 ) KB 130 ( or the High Trees case ) is an English contract law decision in the High Court . However , the most significant part of the judgment is obiter dicta as it relates to hypothetical facts ; that is , the landlord did not seek repayment of the full wartime rent .

answers.question: all i want for christmas is you mariah carey tour
gold_answers: All I Want for Christmas Is You , a Night of Joy and Festivity is the first concert residency by American singer Mariah Carey . Performed annually at the Beacon Theatre in Manhattan , New York , the residency began on December 15 , 2014 , and will conclude on December 22 , 2017 , after completing six legs and thirty - four shows . Billboard revealed that the six dates had sold out with a total of 16,196 tickets while grossing $1.5 million during the first leg of the residency . The main set list for the show encompassed songs from Merry Christmas and Merry Christmas II You , with additional non-holiday tracks . The show also included `` a cast of forty , including a gospel choir , a clutch of carolers , several acrobats and a hyperactive round of kid singer / dancers . ''

answers.question: polar moment of inertia vs area moment of inertia
gold_answers: Polar moment of inertia is a quantity used to predict an object 's ability to resist torsion , in objects ( or segments of objects ) with an invariant circular cross section and no significant warping or out - of - plane deformation . It is used to calculate the angular displacement of an object subjected to a torque . It is analogous to the area moment of inertia , which characterizes an object 's ability to resist bending and is required to calculate displacement .
answers.model_answer: Polar moment: resistance to twisting; area moment: resistance to bending.

answers.question: what does cost of goods sold consist of
gold_answers: Costs are associated with particular goods using one of the several formulas , including specific identification , first - in first - out ( FIFO ) , or average cost . Costs include all costs of purchase , costs of conversion and other costs that are incurred in bringing the inventories to their present location and condition . Costs of goods made by the businesses include material , labor , and allocated overhead . The costs of those goods which are not yet sold are deferred as costs of inventory until the inventory is sold or written down in value .
answers.model_answer: Product and raw-material costs, freight, storage, direct labor, and factory overhead.

gold_answers: Costs are associated with particular goods using one of the several formulas , including specific identification , first - in first - out ( FIFO ) , or average cost . Costs include all costs of purchase , costs of conversion and other costs that are incurred in bringing the inventories to their present location and condition . Costs of goods made by the businesses include material , labor , and allocated overhead . The costs of those goods which are not yet sold are deferred as costs of inventory until the inventory is sold or written down in value .
